name: Leg Up
hint: Stand still and let a friend jump off your head.
why4: Three must be on the ledge to push the 3-block down, and one has to stay below to give them a leg up; with three only two get up.
solution: P1 walks right and stands against the ledge wall (x=13).
P2 jumps onto P1's head, then jumps right onto the ledge (height 3). P3 and P4 do the same, one at a time.
P1 walks back left to x<=9, out from under the ledge edge.
P2, P3, P4 go to the right of the block (P2 at x=18 touching it, P3 at 19, P4 at 20) and all hold Left: the block slides off the ledge and lands on the lower floor next to the wall (x~12-13).
P1 jumps onto the block (height 1), then onto the ledge (2 more).
Someone touches the key at x=25; everyone jumps the 3-wide pit at x=31-33; the key carrier touches the door at x=36; all press Down.
Recovery: anyone who falls in the pit respawns below; once the block is down they climb back via the block. A block pushed right falls in the pit and comes back to its spawn.
